error_help: Check file, format, connection and write permissions. Details are in the error log.
unavailable: Not reliably available in the source
coverage_note: This view shows imported data. Missing amounts are “—”. Data gaps and source differences: Shared → Import review notes.
history_hint: Date: 13.09.2026 · Month: 09.2026 · Year: 2026. Search while typing: 1 finds days 01 and 10–19; 202 finds years 2020–2029. Newest draws first.

not_generated: Combination catalog has not been fully generated yet.
not_drawn: Not found among the imported draws.
frequency_hint: Main numbers in the latest 10/20/50/100/500 and all stored draws, excluding the bonus number. Past frequencies do not predict future draws.
pdf_info: Optional PDF import tool: pdftotext (Poppler). CSV and JSON do not require it.
missing_help: Help for the selected language is missing. Add the matching HTML file to help.
download_hint: Project source: Franz-Dariwudel/6aus45. Enter a language code. Only missing language and help files are installed; active downloads continue after closing this dialog.
download_done: Files checked; missing files installed and existing files preserved.
archive_hint: Checked websites are used for downloads. The official Lotto and Joker archives are listed. Add more archive pages or direct CSV/JSON/Joker PDF links.

select_source: L007: Select at least one website for downloading.
archive_error_help: Check the web address, archive format, internet connection and write permissions in the Downloads and database folders.

history_numbers_invalid: L002: Enter one to six distinct Lotto numbers from 01 to 45, separated by spaces or commas (e.g. 07 23). The field may be empty.
history_filtered_empty: {period} · Lotto numbers: {numbers} · No stored draws contain these main numbers.
inventory_hint: An overview of combination catalogs, imported draws and preserved sources.
inventory_scope: The total includes every table, including combination catalogs, prizes and source links. A complete combination catalog does not establish that the draw archive is complete. Dates reflect imported data.
inventory_storage: Database: {database} bytes · SQLite auxiliary files (WAL/SHM): {auxiliary}. Sizes may change during imports.
s_note: Imported Lotto main numbers only; bonus numbers separately. Missing draws can affect results. Statistics do not predict winning numbers.
s_sort: Click a column heading to sort; click again to reverse the order.
s_empty: No Lotto draws stored. Import archive data using Shared → Download first.
s_no_rows: No matching rows for this selection.
s_error: Unable to load statistics. Check the database path and read permissions; see Help → Error log for details.
s_chart_missing: L001: Chart modules are missing. Install python3-cairo and python3-gi-cairo on Linux Mint, then restart the application. Tables remain available.
s_chart_ready: Move the pointer over bars, curves or matrix cells to see exact values.
s_heat_scale: Frequency: 0 to {maximum} · stronger colour = more frequent
s_diagonal: A number cannot form a pair with itself.
s_neighbor_one: Draws with at least one adjacent pair
s_neighbor_two: Draws with at least two adjacent pairs
s_comparisons: Draws with a known preceding draw
s_ending_combos: Combinations with the same final digit
s_most_hits: Count of the most frequent numbers
s_least_hits: Count of the least frequent numbers
s_hint_overview: Overview of the selected period; all tied numbers are listed.
s_hint_numbers: Gap counts draw steps between occurrences (the next draw = 1). Absence counts missed draws. ≥ means never drawn within the period; — means unavailable.
s_hint_expectation: Compare observed frequencies with their statistical expectations. Deviations and their magnitude describe only the selected archive.
s_hint_draws: Sections show values, patterns and gaps. The six main numbers are sorted ascending; their actual drawing order is not assumed.
s_hint_ranges: Ranges: 01–09, 10–19, 20–29, 30–39, 40–45. Shares use all drawn main numbers; the ranges have different sizes.
s_hint_parity: Distribution = even / odd. Example 2 / 4: two even and four odd main numbers.
s_hint_low_high: Distribution = low / high. Low: 01–22; high: 23–45. Example 2 / 4: two low and four high main numbers.
s_hint_sums: Sum of the six main numbers in each draw. The median is the middle ordered sum (the mean of the two middle values for an even count).
s_hint_pairs: All 990 possible pairs, including zero counts. The number filter requires every entered number. — for date or absence means never drawn together in this period.
s_hint_triples: All 14,190 possible triples, including zero counts. The number filter requires every entered number. Page controls provide access to every result.
s_hint_neighbors: Adjacent numbers differ by 1. A run of three contains two adjacent pairs. Run lists contain maximal consecutive runs of length 2 or more.
s_hint_repeats: Compared with the preceding stored Lotto draw, including the draw just before the selected window. The first archive draw has no comparison. Same-day draws follow database ID order.
s_hint_endings: Final digits 0–9; frequency counts numbers, “at least two” counts draws. Combinations include all possible groups sharing a final digit, including unseen groups.
s_hint_gaps: Five differences between successive sorted main numbers per draw. Percentages refer to all these gaps.
s_hint_periods: Frequencies for numbers 01–45 side by side. If fewer draws are available, all available draws are used; actual window sizes are shown above.
s_hint_rankings: Select the ranking section. Ties share a rank (1, 1, 3). ≥ marks a minimum absence; — an unavailable value.
s_hint_charts: Select a chart and period. For timelines, type the desired number directly into the number field.
s_chart_hint_frequency: Count of each main number in the selected period.
s_chart_hint_pause: Missed draws since the last occurrence. For unseen numbers, bar height is only a lower bound (≥ in the tooltip).
s_chart_hint_timeline: Cumulative share of the chosen number since the start of the window. Dashed: statistical expectation. Each point represents a stored draw.
s_chart_hint_sums: Number of draws in each sum range of the six main numbers.
s_chart_hint_parity: Number of draws for each even / odd split.
s_chart_hint_low_high: Number of draws for each low (01–22) / high (23–45) split.
s_chart_hint_heatmap: Row and column select the two numbers; both halves contain the same pair frequencies. The diagonal is empty.
s_chart_hint_deviation: Difference between cumulative frequency and its expectation since the start of the window. Dashed: no deviation.

lookup_hint_lotto: Search only Lotto combinations that were actually drawn. Enter one to six distinct numbers, e.g. 07 or 07 23; searching starts with the first number. All entered main numbers must occur. The bonus number is excluded. Every stored draw date is shown for each match.
lookup_hint_joker: Search only Joker numbers that were actually drawn. Enter one to six digits; searching starts with the first digit. The sequence can occur anywhere, e.g. 23 in 001234. Leading zeros are preserved.
lookup_invalid_lotto: L002: Enter one to six distinct Lotto numbers from 01 to 45, separated by spaces or commas.
lookup_invalid_joker: L002: Enter one to six Joker digits without separators, e.g. 0, 23 or 001234.
database_help: Check the filename, location and read permissions. Restore a renamed database to the expected name or use --db to select its other path. Use a backup for damaged files. Then choose Refresh. A new archive can be created through Shared → Download.
database_empty_help: This file contains no Lotto combinations, Joker numbers or draws. Check whether the populated database is stored under another name. To create a new dataset, use Shared → Download, then choose Refresh.
recovery_hint: An existing database or backup restores your saved dataset. Without a backup, you can download available draws and regenerate all possible combinations. Personal additions can only be recovered from a backup.
recovery_cancelled: Recovery cancelled. The previous database selection is preserved.
recovery_partial: {count} download errors: The new dataset includes only successfully downloaded sources. Missing archives can be downloaded again later.
recovery_error_help: Check the file, free disk space and write permissions. For a rebuild, also check download sources and the internet connection. Existing databases were not replaced.
recovery_save_error: L010: The new database was created, but its selection could not be saved: {path}. Check write permissions for config.
recovery_rebuild_hint: The selected websites provide available draws. All 8,145,060 Lotto combinations and 1,000,000 Joker numbers are also generated. A new database is used only after validation; existing files are preserved. Personal additions and unavailable original sources require a backup. Rebuilding may take several minutes.
settings_error_help: Check settings. Until corrected, the default database is used; an explicit --db path takes precedence.
quotes_hint: Only draws with stored prize records are shown. Search by date, month/year or year. “All prizes” or an empty date field opens the year and month selection. Amounts are per winner; jackpots are marked. “—” means unknown, 0 means zero. Historical amounts retain ATS or EUR.
quotes_empty: No prize records stored for this selection.
quotes_results: Draws with prize records: {draws} · Stored prize records: {quotes}. Rows {first}–{last} of {total}.
review_intro: You do not need to handle these notes during normal use. They explain why some downloaded details were not imported or differ between sources. They also include harmless explanatory text from archives.
review_count: {count} stored notes. This is not a count of missing draws. A note may concern text, individual details or a complete draw.
review_postponed_body: The archive contains an explanation instead of winning numbers, for example that a draw was moved to 01.01.1987. This text was not imported as a separate draw. The note alone does not mean a draw is missing.
review_cancelled_body: The source marks this scheduled draw as cancelled. There are no winning numbers to import for that entry. The note records the archive text and does not mean numbers were lost during import.
review_archive_note_body: This is explanatory text, for example about introducing two Lotto draws per week. It contains no winning numbers and is therefore not counted as a draw.
review_quote_conflict_body: Two imported source versions contain different details for the same prize class, such as winner count, amount or jackpot status. The existing prize record was kept during that import. The differing information remains in the details; this note does not automatically concern the winning numbers.
review_draw_conflict_body: Another source gives different numbers for the same draw. The existing numbers were kept during that import; the conflicting draw was not adopted. For example, two Joker dates in the additional archive differed from the previously imported official source. The note alone does not determine which source is correct.
review_duplicate_title: Ambiguous Joker date in the additional archive
review_duplicate_body: The additional Joker archive lists the same date more than once, for example 25.03.2026 with two different numbers. These ambiguous rows were not imported. A draw already stored from another source is retained.
review_invalid_order_title: Inconsistent draw order or bonus number
review_invalid_order_body: The additional draw-order data does not match the main numbers, or gives a different bonus number. The conflicting order was not imported; usable main numbers and the primary bonus number are retained. Missing draw order does not mean the entire draw is missing.
review_order_conflict_body: Another source gives a different order for the same numbers. The existing draw order was kept during that import. This note does not change the main numbers.
review_invalid_quote_body: A winner count or amount could not be read. That prize record was not imported; other usable information may be available. In Prize amounts, “—” means an unknown value. The original row is retained for review.
review_unknown_body: A row or individual details could not be processed reliably. These notes cannot safely be classified as harmless archive text. The details show the source, original message and raw data so the cause can be investigated.
tip_warning: Every combination has the same chance in a fair draw. Historical filters structure tips; they do not improve winning chances.
status_line: DB: Lotto {lotto} · Joker {joker} | Data check: {check} | Update: {update} | Internet: {internet}
s_hint_patterns: Descriptive patterns in the selected period. Weekdays: 0 Monday to 6 Sunday. E/O means even/odd.
new_database: A new empty database was created. Use “Check for new data” to import historical draws.
s_chart_hint_zscore: Deviation from expectation divided by standard deviation; descriptive only.
rule_multiplicity: Occurrences of the same digit: maximum
tip_unusual_description: Extreme sum, parity or consecutive run
rule_settings_hint: Enable these values using checkboxes when creating tips. Saving does not change earlier batches.
rule_scope_title: Reference period for tip filters (shared within this game)
rule_input_error: Enter valid numbers; separate range limits with commas.
tip_rule_locations: Set values under “Configure tip filters” in the named statistics page. Enable the desired filters here.
